_comment: OWNER OWNED. The pacing budget for social media page loads from this Mac, shared by
every job (Jev, Astra, Claude workers, scripts). Read fresh on every call by
~/.claude/scripts/social-load-audit.py. There is no env or flag override: changing a
number is an edit to this file, the same doctrine as peer-refresh-allow.json.
local  = anything that leaves from this Mac's IP: any browser, curl, Playwright, CDP.
remote = a renderer that fetches from its own IP (Cloudflare Browser Rendering and the
hosts in remote_renderers). Looser, still logged, still capped.
Every budget is PER PLATFORM. per_hour is a rolling 60 minutes, per_day is the local
calendar day in the Mac's system zone (/etc/localtime, never the TZ variable; an optional
day_zone key pins another). per_hour 0 means no hourly cap. min_gap_s is the floor of the gap; the
gap itself is drawn from the governor model named in gap_model, scaled so its floor
lands on min_gap_s (see social-gate.py). Proposed by M on 2026-09-26 for Zalo.
Only Zalo edits this file and the state files, in his own terminal: the hook refuses
agent writes to them (a deleted ledger would reset every cap).

not_page_hosts._comment: Authenticated platform APIs, not page loads: the BU ads check (schedule #71) and the Delta Agents Meta and WhatsApp providers call graph.facebook.com with a token. They are rate limited by the platform's API, not read as browsing. Remove a host here to pace it like a page.

blueprint._comment: The GoHighLevel browser. It NEVER loads a social host, gated or not.
